description:
Get electricity retail prices, generation, or consumption by state and sector.

Sectors: residential (RES), commercial (COM), industrial (IND), transportation (TRA), all (ALL).
Data types: 'price' (cents/kWh), 'revenue' (M$), 'sales' (MWh), 'customers'

end.description: End date (YYYY-MM or YYYY). Default: latest available

length.description: Max rows (API max: 5000). Omit to let date range control volume.

start.description: Start date (YYYY-MM or YYYY). Default: 2 years ago

state.description: State name, two-letter code or FIPS code (e.g. 'California', 'CA', '06'). Omit for national.

name: eia_electricity
